theorems.name: Submission.deformation_retraction_cube_core
theorems.statement: ∀ m ℓ : ℕ, 1 ≤ ℓ → ∃ c₁ : ℝ, 0 ≤ c₁ ∧ ∀ a : Eucl (m + 1 + ℓ), (∀ i, 1 / 4 < a i ∧ a i < 3 / 4) → ∀ La : Set (Eucl (m + 1 + ℓ)), La = {y | ∃ J : Finset (Fin (m + 1 + ℓ)), J.card = m + 2 ∧ ∀ i ∈ J, ∃ k : ℤ, y i - a i = k} → ∃ ψ₀ : Eucl (m + 1 + ℓ) → Eucl (m + 1 + ℓ), (∀ x : Eucl (m + 1 + ℓ), (∀ i, 0 ≤ x i ∧ x i ≤ 1) → x ∉ La → (∀ i, 0 ≤ ψ₀ x i ∧ ψ₀ x i ≤ 1) ∧ ∃ I : Finset (Fin (m + 1 + ℓ)), I.card = ℓ ∧ ∀ i ∈ I, ψ₀ x i = 0 ∨ ψ₀ x i = 1) ∧ (∀ x x' : Eucl (m + 1 + ℓ), (∀ i, 0 ≤ x i ∧ x i ≤ 1) → x ∉ La → (∀ i, 0 ≤ x' i ∧ x' i ≤ 1) → x' ∉ La → (∀ i, ∃ k : ℤ, x' i - x i = k) → ∀ i, ψ₀ x' i - ψ₀ x i = x' i - x i) ∧ ∀ x : Eucl (m + 1 + ℓ), (∀ i, 0 ≤ x i ∧ x i ≤ 1) → x ∉ La → ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧ ∀ x' : Eucl (m + 1 + ℓ), (∀ i, 0 ≤ x' i ∧ x' i ≤ 1) → x' ∉ La → dist x' x < δ → dist (ψ₀ x') (ψ₀ x) ≤ (c₁ / infDist x La + ε) * dist x' x
